versions.changelog:
- Updated documentation files: README.md and README_CN.md have been revised for clarity and content improvements.
- Removed deprecated documentation file: skill-card.md is no longer included in this version.
- No changes to core functionality or workflow; this release focuses on documentation cleanup and maintenance.

- Added detailed interactive coaching flows for habit diagnosis, mission statement drafting, check-in plan customization, emotional bank account auditing, and time matrix organization.
- Strictly enforced actionable, scenario-based suggestions with clear completion standards for check-in tasks.
- Outlined IRON LAW and coaching style guidelines to ensure practical, user-centered support—no generic theory or excessive encouragement.
- Included crisis escalation boundaries and fallback procedures if reference files are missing.
- Provided quick reference tables for the Seven Habits and user growth stages to support concise and targeted coaching.
